name: WFK Menu Import/Export
author: YH Sajib

sections.description:
WFK Menu Import/Export is the ultimate tool for managing WordPress navigation menus. Whether you are migrating a site, backing up your configuration, or moving menus from a local development environment to a live server, this plugin makes it effortless.

With a simple and intuitive interface, you can export your menus to a JSON file and import them into any other WordPress site with just a few clicks.

Key Features:

  • Easy Export: Export any or all navigation menus to a downloadable file.
  • Seamless Import: Import menus from a backup file instantly.
  • Migration Friendly: Perfect for developers moving sites from localhost to production.
  • Backup & Restore: Keep a safe backup of your complex menu structures.
  • User-Friendly Interface: Simple admin dashboard under Appearance > Menu Import/Export.
  • JSON Format: Uses lightweight and standard JSON format for data transfer.

Why Use WFK Menu Import/Export?

Moving WordPress menus manually can be tedious, especially if you have complex hierarchies. This plugin automates the process, ensuring all your menu items, links, and structures are preserved exactly as they are.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wfk-menu-import-export folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Appearance > Menu Import/Export to start managing your menus.
sections.faq:
Can I import menus to a different domain?

Yes! The plugin exports the menu structure. When you import it to a new site, it attempts to map the menu items. Note that if you have custom links to specific internal pages, you might need to check them, but the structure remains intact.

Does this support mega menus?

It supports standard WordPress menu items. If your mega menu uses standard WordPress menu classes and structure, it should work.

What format is the export file?

The plugin exports data in .json format, which is lightweight and easy to read.
